name: Aguilar

nadir.desc: The property consists of a multi-section primary residence with a dark shingle roof and light-colored walls|Multiple smaller detached structures with varied roofing are present|The majority of the open ground around the buildings is occupied by numerous parked vehicles|Stacks of tires and outdoor materials are visible throughout the lot|Fencing encloses the property perimeter.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a light-colored multi-section house with a dark roof|Numerous vehicles are parked densely in front of and around the structure|Detached structures and stacks of tires are present|Fencing is visible along the perimeter.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the house and adjacent detached structures|Dense concentrations of parked vehicles, tires, and outdoor materials fill the available ground space|Fencing continues along the perimeter.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the house and multiple detached structures|Parked vehicles occupy most of the open ground|Outdoor materials and fencing enclose the rear portion of the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation of the house and surrounding area|Numerous vehicles are parked densely along this side|Detached structures, outdoor materials, and fencing continue along the perimeter.

considerations: Vehicle access from the road leads toward the front of the residence, though dense concentrations of parked vehicles occupy most of the available ground space around the buildings. Open movement around the structures is significantly limited by the number of vehicles, tires, and outdoor materials present. Multiple detached structures are located on the property. Fencing encloses the perimeter. The property is located in a rural setting with neighboring structures nearby.
clarifications: Is there a clear path from the road to the primary residence that remains accessible for emergency vehicles? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle access available to the rear of the house? What is the purpose of the multiple detached structures? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery?
